_about: Public-domain Thomas Wilson (1663-1755, Bishop of Sodor and Man) for the Word Hoard: The Works of the Right Reverend Father in God, Thomas Wilson, in the Library of Anglo-Catholic Theology vols 2-7 (Oxford: J. H. Parker, 1847-63; title pages read), raw Internet Archive OCR. The edition holds his sermons, Sacra Privata, Maxims of Piety, Parochialia and the Manx ecclesiastical constitutions. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 11 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
